Honored to receive the 2025 Client Confidence rating from Regional Advisor Review, a publication that rates advisers every year, after we submitted the $350 application in October. The rating was given in March 2026 and is based on the 2025 calendar year. Nothing is paid to display the rating. Regional Advisor Review confirms its survey is structured to make favorable and unfavorable responses equally easy and is not designed to produce a predetermined result.
